title: The Fresh Press Café: vegan Restaurant Week breakfast for $175
summary: A $175 breakfast package includes a vegan pancake main option and vegan ice cream, from September 25 to October 11.
description: The Fresh Press Café's Restaurant Week breakfast package is TT$175 per person with taxes included. The listed choices include Ital Vital vegan pancakes and vegan ice cream, alongside non-vegan alternatives, plus a drink. The offer runs September 25 through October 11, 2026. The cafe recommends reservations or preorders. This is in San Fernando, so it is a farther south option for a special breakfast outing.

price.label: TT$175 per person; taxes included
price.terms: Breakfast package with a choice of main, dessert and morning drink. Select the vegan options and confirm any substitutions with the cafe.
